actions.name: Projectile Entry
actions.description:
Trigger: The user would Fling a @Trait[ball] item.

Effect: The user instead Flings the specific @Trait[ball] item that is currently storing a creature on their Team or stores a creature on their Team currently in Combat.

The creature currently stored in the Ball enters Combat as per @UUID[Compendium.ptr2e.core-moves.XJ6olVrexEHDTqTM]{Send Out}, or the creature normally stored in the Ball leaves Combat as per @UUID[Compendium.ptr2e.core-moves.MXPyYtoPDsZ4ByPh]{Recall} if they are within 3m of the target.

cost.trigger: The user would Fling a @Trait[ball] item.

system.description:
Effect: The user can spend @PP[-2] when they would Fling a @Trait[ball] item to instead Fling the specific @Trait[ball] item that is currently storing a creature on their Team or stores a creature on their Team currently in Combat. This inflicts damage to the target with the Fling as normal (use a temporary stock of the specific @Trait[ball] item as needed for Fling).

Following this attack, the creature stored in the Ball enters Combat as per the Fling application of @UUID[Compendium.ptr2e.core-moves.XJ6olVrexEHDTqTM]{Send Out}, or the creature normally stored in the Ball leaves Combat as per @UUID[Compendium.ptr2e.core-moves.MXPyYtoPDsZ4ByPh]{Recall} if they are within 3m of the target of Fling.
